_comment: Points in pixels of car-source.jpg. tank = outline of the car body (clips the liquid); floor_quad = the car's floor as far-front, near-front, near-rear, far-rear corner (sides parallel to the car's length and width; the liquid is a box standing on it); liquid_height = height of that box at 100 %; power_text / energy_text = start of the texts on the plate, edge_angle = angle of the plate's front edges in degrees; wallbox_top = where the feed line enters the wallbox.
